subject: EmbeddedPkg/Universal/MmcDxe: Fix VS2022 NOOPT IA32/X64 issues
reasons: The commit applies the same type-narrowing and explicit-cast pattern across two C files.
Several call sites switch from wider `UINTN` values to `UINT32` or `UINT16` with consistent casts.
The transformation is mechanical enough to describe as a reusable match-and-replace rule.
candidate_pattern: Narrow MMC command-argument and card-state variables to 32-bit or 16-bit types and insert explicit casts at the affected assignments and call sites.
